caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a goblet or chalice, rendered in grayscale pencil or ink. The goblet has a wide, slightly flared rim and a smooth, conical bowl that tapers down to a narrow stem, which then connects to a broad, circular base. A decorative band encircles the upper portion of the bowl, featuring a repeated pattern of wavy, horizontal lines and loops. To the right of the goblet, there is a rectangular inset that magnifies this decorative pattern, showing the details of the wavy lines and loops in a more prominent way. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Pewter Chalice
